mentions.name: Fugleramme
mentions.description: An E-ink bird frame for Raspberry Pi that performs real-time bird detection by audio using fully local AI (BirdNET-Go) and displays the detected birds as real, hand-cut 1800s bird illustrations.
mentions.source_excerpt: An E-ink bird frame for Raspberry Pi - with real-time bird detection by audio, fully local AI, driven by BirdNET-Go rendered as real, hand-cut 1800s bird illustrations.
mentions.author: arnemunthekaas
